podcast.body: This song marks the first recorded instance of the word "Reggae" appearing in a song, serving as an early introduction to the term, if not the music genre itself. "Or at least, that is the first time that the word showed up in a song courtesy of Toots and the Maytals and their song Do the Reggae."
